title: Salvation as Latch, Walk as Sector
claim: χ is a measurement instrument. Salvation is a latch — irreversible, non-decreasing, never unset. The walk is a sector that can rise and fall. A man can be saved and far from God at the same time. χ measures the walk and records the latch. It does not set either.
assumptions: The Master Equation measures alignment, not salvation status
definitions: Sector: can rise and fall, measures current alignment
bridges: Soteriology: salvation as permanent status vs progressive sanctification
negative_guards: χ is not the salvation variable. The identification of the latch mechanism is a bridge claim.
This distinction prevents the equation from being read as 'works-based salvation.'
kill_conditions: Show that the latch/sector distinction is mathematically incoherent.
Show that χ must set salvation status rather than merely recording it.
